item.title: EUR/USD drifts lower as Eurozone HICP and unemployment grow | FXStreet
item.description: EUR/USD has retraced previous gains, following the release of the Eurozone's inflation and unemployment figures, and turned negative in the daily chart. The pair is testing the 1.1600 level at the time of writing, following rejection at the 1.1650 area on Monday.

item.title: Euro-area inflation holds at ECB target in November – Nordea | FXStreet
item.description: The Euro-area flash inflation estimate for November remained close to the ECB’s target at 2% y/y, supporting an ECB that is on hold unless new shocks appear.

item.title: The S&P 500 is gearing up for a Christmas rally | FXStreet
item.description: Rising US Treasury yields and renewed selling of cryptocurrencies have cooled demand in the S&P 500. The broad stock index took a step back after a five-day rally, but its outlook remains bullish.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD faces selling pressure above $4,200 as US Dollar rebounds | FXStreet
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) is down 1% to near $4,180.00 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The yellow metal slumps after failing to hold above $4,200 as the US Dollar (USD) bounces back despite weak United States (US) ISM manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data for November.

item.title: ECB’s Nagel: German economy may grow by over 1% in 2027 | FXStreet
item.description: European Central Bank (ECB) Governing Council (GC) member Joachim Nagel said during Tuesday’s European session that inflation in the Eurozone is practically at target and will stay near these levels.

item.title: USD/JPY picks up to levels past 156.00 amid an improving market mood | FXStreet
item.description: The US Dollar remains bid against a softening Japanese Yen on Tuesday's European trading session. A somewhat brighter market mood is weighing on JPY, and provides support to the Greenback to extend its recovery from Monday’s lows near 154.65 to levels above 156.00 at the time of writing.

item.title: Gold retreats from six-week highs with Fed cut bets limiting downside | FXStreet
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) edges lower on Tuesday as traders lock in some profits following Monday’s surge to six-week highs. At the time of writing, XAU/USD is trading near $4,197, down nearly 0.95% on the day.

item.title: Pound Sterling weakens against US Dollar ahead of key US data | FXStreet
item.description: The Pound Sterling (GBP) drops to near 1.3190 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Tuesday. The GBP/USD pair falls as the US Dollar extends Monday's recovery move despite weak United States (US) ISM Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data for November.
